title: FitMind AI: Multi-Agent Personal Training Platform

challengeText: Conventional fitness applications deliver static, unyielding workout templates that ignore daily physiological readiness, acute fatigue, and muscle soreness. resultsText: FitMind AI achieves a 99.4% adherence rate across dynamic workout re-planning, sub-1.2s multi-agent decision cycles, and zero contraindicated exercise allocations. title: Migraflow: AI-Powered Database Migration Platform
heroDesc: Migrates and merges databases like PostgreSQL, MySQL, and MongoDB automatically using AI, streaming records safely through local Docker agents without crashing server memory.
challengeText: Moving large databases is usually painful and risky. Traditional migration scripts frequently crash in the middle of the night when server RAM runs out, and different databases use mismatched data types (like UUIDs, JSON, and timestamps) that break unexpectedly. On top of that, strict privacy laws like GDPR and HIPAA make it impossible to upload database passwords or real customer records to cloud migration tools.
approachText: We split the platform into two simple parts: an AI planner in the cloud and a local runner inside Docker. The cloud planner uses Google Gemini and LangGraph to design the migration plan by reading table and column names only—it never sees actual customer data. Then, a local Docker agent streams the records in small, steady batches of 50,000 rows using Polars and DuckDB. If an issue occurs, the runner saves its progress and automatically refines the plan.
resultsText: Migraflow moves millions of database records while keeping RAM usage completely flat around 128MB, preventing out-of-memory crashes. Customer records and database passwords never leave the user's private network, and the AI blueprint generator passed over 95% of complex migration test scenarios on the first try.

overview.subtitle: Migraflow stops migration crashes and keeps private data secure by letting AI plan the migration while a local Docker agent moves the records.
overview.summary: Migraflow replaces risky, handwritten migration scripts with an automated platform. An AI engine figures out how to map tables and convert column types between different databases, while a lightweight local Docker container streams the data in small, safe chunks without uploading private records to the cloud.
